changes: Stopping your share now stops its sound too. You can still share sound on its own.
4K streams now load: their picture could fail to appear.
When your computer briefly can't keep up at the start, Bellion no longer drops you to a lower quality for good, and it tries your chosen quality again later.
Bellion opens where you left it, at the same size, after an update or restart.
The scroll bar under the quality choices no longer covers them.
The volume slider on a video moves again when you click or drag it, and the other buttons on that bar update again.
Each person has a speaker next to the eye: click it to mute them for you. It lights up while they talk, and shows when they send no audio.
Sounds and auto-watch moved from the settings menu to buttons at the bottom right of the call: the music note, and the eye with play or stop.
Including voice chat apps in whole-system audio is now a checkbox under Whole system in Share options.
Buttons show a tooltip when you rest the mouse on them.
Discord: connect your account once in the browser and Bellion Share follows your voice channel. Discord doesn't need to run on this computer.
The connection to the Bellion Share server accepts only certificates from its public authorities, so a company proxy or antivirus can't read it. Your own servers can be pinned too (Servers...).
After an update, Bellion Share shows what changed. Help > What's new shows it any time.
A new update shows its changes for 30 seconds when it's found.
Updates no longer fail on slow connections, and the banner shows download progress.
Whole-system audio leaves out voice chat apps (Discord, TeamSpeak...), so others in the voice call don't hear voices twice. Settings can include them.
Closing a stream window closes it and stops that stream, sound too. The eye brings it back.
Fixes smeared video that wouldn't recover.
Video windows show 60 fps streams at 60.
A 4K60 share the encoder can't keep up with steps down instead of silently halving the frame rate.
Windows: Bellion Share keeps full speed behind a fullscreen game.
Stops a log flood while sharing and watching.
Fixes shared sound going silent on Linux after about half a second (viewers heard nothing).
Adds a Test tone audio option to check that others hear you, plus audio diagnostics in logs.
